title: Senior Clinical SAS Programmer
description:
**Job Description:**
Job Title: Senior Clinical SAS Programmer
  
  
Job Location: India (Remote)
  
  
Job Overview:
  
  
The Senior Clinical SAS Programmer supports Clinipace data operations by providing programming services to Data Management. This position works under the supervision of management and will assist in various assigned programming and reporting tasks.
  
  
Job Duties and Responsibilities:
  
  
Typical responsibilities and opportunities include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Program complex data checks and data reconciliation reports.
* Create special reports using SAS and other tools as requested from the Data Management department.
* Merge external data with EDC data and check for consistency.
* Transform SAS datasets, delimited data files, and other file types to Excel for data review.
* Automate these reports as necessary for most efficient use by the team members.
* Collaborate and communicate with a wide variety of team members, both situated locally and across the world and in different functional areas.
* Offer advice on efficiencies for presenting data for cleaning processes to more easily identify potential data issues in clinical trials.
* Mentor and assist more junior level programmers.
* Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
  
  
No supervisory responsibilities
  
  
Job Requirements:
  
  
Education
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Biostatistics, Statistics, or Computer Science or equivalent work experience to demonstrate knowledge and skills.

**Experience**

* 5 or more years’ experience providing advanced statistical programming services
* Advanced knowledge of data step, proc import, proc sql, and ods programming in SAS.
* Knowledge of clinical trial databases, including an understanding of data reports for clinical trials, is preferred.
* Experience identifying common data entry errors and creating reports to make querying the data points efficient for the data managers.

Skills/Competencies
  
  

* Data merge, transpose, sorting, other manipulation concepts.
* Proficient with SAS data programming and reporting using proc report and ods.
* Able to create programs that anticipate and identify potential problems that may or may not exist at the time of development.
* Ability to create visualizations using SAS graphics language is preferred.
* Understanding of UNIX, Windows, and Powershell commands preferred.
* Ability to review requests and determine best approach to maximize the usefulness of the report or listing.
* Ability to problem solve by using available resources with little oversight.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.
* Computer skills including a clear understanding of Microsoft Excel functions and formatting.
* Effective time management and organizational skills
* Ability to effectively handle multiple projects at once

Capabilities
  
  

* Ability to work remotely as needed.

The company will not accept unsolicited resumes from third party vendors.

title: SAP EWM Technical
description:
Job Title: SAP EWM Technical
  
  
**Experience Level:**
4 – 7 Years
  
  
**Location:**
PAN INDIA
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and skilled
**SAP EWM Technical Developer**
to design, build, and optimize advanced Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) solutions. In this role, you will work closely with functional teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical implementations, ensuring seamless warehouse operations and high-performing system integrations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Development & Enhancement
  
  

* Custom Objects: Design, develop, and enhance core EWM technical objects, including RF (Radio Frequency) screens, IDocs, BAdIs, user exits, and custom interfaces.
* Warehouse Processes: Provide technical support and custom enhancements for key warehouse workflows: Inbound, Outbound, Putaway, Picking, Packing, and Inventory Management.

Integration & Architecture
  
  

* System Connectivity: Build and maintain seamless integrations between SAP EWM and ECC or S/4HANA using qRFC, Web Services, and APIs.
* Warehouse Objects: Leverage deep understanding of core warehouse objects such as Warehouse Tasks (WT), Warehouse Orders (WO), Goods Receipt (GR), and Goods Issue (GI).

Optimization & Support
  
  

* Performance Tuning: Perform rigorous debugging, issue resolution, and performance optimization for custom EWM code and database queries.
* Project Lifecycle: Participate actively in full-lifecycle EWM implementations, rollouts, or ongoing support projects.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with functional consultants and business analysts to translate functional specifications into clean, scalable technical solutions.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 4 to 7 years of hands-on SAP EWM technical development experience.
* Core ABAP: Strong background in ABAP, OO ABAP, and modern development paradigms including ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, and AMDP (Managed Database Procedures).
* EWM Technical Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with the RF Framework, EWM Monitor enhancements, BAdIs, and enhancement spots.
* Integration Protocols: Demonstrated proficiency in building interfaces using qRFC, Web Services, and APIs.
* Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving capabilities, strong debugging skills, and clear communication to collaborate effectively across global or cross-functional teams.

title: SAP FI-DRC - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP FI-DRC - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**The Team**
Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting team helps organizations align tax, finance, and technology to support operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. The team works with clients to design and implement technology-enabled solutions across tax reporting, process transformation, and SAP-led modernization initiatives. Professionals in this practice collaborate across tax, finance, and technology functions to help clients address complex business and compliance needs.
  
  
As part of Deloitte Tax in India, you will work with multinational clients to address statutory reporting, e-invoicing, and finance process requirements in an evolving global tax environment. This role offers the opportunity to support complex implementations, collaborate across stakeholders, and contribute to large-scale tax technology initiatives.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a
**Senior, Tax Technology Services**
on the Tax Technology Consulting team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Supporting the implementation of statutory reporting solutions in SAP environments
* Supporting the implementation of e-invoicing solutions for client tax and finance operations
* Gathering business and functional requirements from clients and translating them into implementation support activities
* Coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to support solution design, testing, and deployment
* Contributing to SAP finance transformation initiatives involving financial posting processes and tax-related operational requirements

**Location: All Locations**
**Shift Timings: Regular hours**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience with SAP S/4HANA, or participation in 3 full lifecycle SAP implementations
* Experience supporting global template preparation and rollout activities
* Experience configuring or supporting SAP Finance (FI) processes including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Electronic Bank Statement, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders
* Experience supporting Procure to Pay, Record to Report, and Order to Cash processes
* Experience working with SAP Finance (FI), Controlling (CO), and integration with Sales and Distribution (SD) and Materials Management (MM)
* Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP)
* Experience supporting change requests, enhancements, or functional improvements in SAP Finance and Controlling environments

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions
* Experience with statutory reporting and e-invoicing implementations
* Experience with European Union tax business processes
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with multiple stakeholder groups
* Experience supporting SAP Finance and Controlling initiatives as an individual contributor or team lead

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. title: SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

title: Field Signal Processing & Data Analysis Engineer
description:
We are looking for a
**Field Signal Processing & Data Analysis Engineer**
to manage mission data workflows, validate sensor data quality, and ensure successful transfer of field-acquired data into processing pipelines.

Responsibilities

* Create and manage flight missions and acquisition plans based on operational requirements.
* Perform post-flight data transfer, validation, and quality checks.
* Verify data integrity including file completeness, timestamps, navigation data, and acquisition parameters.
* Perform preliminary analysis of radar and sensor data to identify anomalies.
* Maintain traceability between flight configuration, acquired data, and processing outputs.
* Prepare structured data handover packages for signal processing teams.
* Support troubleshooting of data acquisition, navigation, and processing issues.
* Maintain technical documentation including flight records, data logs, and analysis reports.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Electronics, Computer Science, Computer Applications, Signal Processing, or related field.
* Experience in technical data analysis and scientific data workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret complex datasets.

title: Package Consultant-SAP HANA SCM WMS
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA SCM WMS, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring SAP S/4HANA Stock room Management solutions for clients. Your expertise will enable clients to optimize their warehouse operations, improve inventory management, and increase logistics efficiency.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design and Implement Solutions: Work closely with clients to understand their business requirements and design SAP S/4HANA Stock room Management warehouse solutions tailored to their needs.
* Provide Training and Support: Deliver training and support to ensure a smooth transition to the new solution, enabling clients to maximize its benefits.
* Optimize Warehouse Operations: Implement and configure SAP S/4HANA Stock room Management solutions to optimize warehouse operations, improve inventory management, and increase logistics efficiency.
* Collaborate with Clients: Engage with clients to understand their business needs and preferences, ensuring that the delivered solution meets their expectations.
* Ensure Smooth Transition: Provide ongoing support to ensure the successful adoption of the implemented solution.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* SAP S/4HANA Configuration: Experience with configuring SAP S/4HANA Stock room Management solutions to meet client business requirements and optimize warehouse operations.
* Warehouse Solution Design: Experience in designing SAP S/4HANA Stock room Management warehouse solutions tailored to client needs and preferences.
* Logistics Efficiency Improvement: Experience with implementing solutions that improve inventory management and increase logistics efficiency for clients.
* Client Business Requirements Analysis: Experience working with clients to understand their business requirements and design solutions that meet their needs.
* SAP S/4HANA Implementation: Experience with implementing SAP S/4HANA Stock room Management solutions and providing training and support for smooth transition.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

title: Package Consultant-SAP HANA SCM GTS
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant for SAP HANA SCM GTS, you will guide business stakeholders through the design and functional implementation of SAP Global Trade Services to enable compliant and efficient cross-border trade operations. This role involves delivering solutions and collaborating with stakeholders to achieve this goal.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Process Design: Translating trade compliance and customs requirements into scalable process designs covering sanctioned-party screening, embargo/legal control, and license determination.
* Implementation Leadership: Leading Fit-to-Standard workshops and defining end-to-end process flows across order-to-cash and procure-to-pay.
* Configuration Management: Configuring GTS objects, such as legal regulations, control classes, and business partners, to ensure robust integration with S/4HANA and other systems.
* Test Strategy: Driving test strategy, including unit, SIT, and UAT, to ensure the solution meets the requirements.
* Data Migration: Managing data migration, including business partner and classification data, to support the implementation.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* SAP GTS Expertise: Exposure to SAP Global Trade Services, edition for SAP HANA, with knowledge of its application in enabling compliant and efficient cross-border trade operations.
* Process Design Experience: Experience working with trade compliance and customs requirements to design scalable process flows, including sanctioned-party screening and license determination.
* Configuration Skills: Ability to configure GTS objects, such as legal regulations and control classes, to ensure integration with S/4HANA and other systems.
* Test Strategy Development: Exposure to driving test strategies, including unit, SIT, and UAT, to ensure solution requirements are met.
* Data Migration Knowledge: Experience with data migration, including business partner and classification data, to support implementation and integration with external systems.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Technical Integration Skills: Exposure to integrating SAP GTS with S/4HANA, EWM/TM, and external customs brokers/content providers.
* Data Analysis Knowledge: Experience with data migration and management, including business partner and classification data.
* Test Automation Tools: Familiarity with tools for automating unit, SIT, and UAT testing to ensure solution requirements are met.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
**Position Summary**

We are hiring a Salesforce Developer with development depth to own the day-to-day health of our Salesforce environment and to build the automation, integrations, and custom functionality the business runs on. Salesforce is the enterprise CRM system of record and sits alongside Salesforce CPQ, Certinia (PSA, SCM, OIM), and NetSuite as part of MGT's consolidated stack.

This role sits on the Platforms Enterprise Applications team, which holds central governance over Salesforce across all MGT business units. Configuration changes, enhancements, bug fixes, and development work move through this team under a common SDLC and a single release process. Business units request and prioritize; this team designs, builds, and deploys.

The work is hands-on and split roughly 60/40 between configuration, release management, and platform governance on one side, and Apex, Lightning Web Components, and integration work on the other. You will support multiple business units as their processes converge onto a single org, so comfort with competing requirements and legacy workflows is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Development**

* Build and maintain Apex triggers using a single-trigger-per-object handler pattern, along with batch, queueable, and scheduled Apex.
* Develop Lightning Web Components and Screen Flows for user-facing functionality; extend standard objects before introducing custom ones.
* Write and maintain unit tests with meaningful assertions, not coverage padding; hold the org above the deployment threshold with a target of 90%+ on new code.
* Write efficient SOQL and design for governor limits and large data volumes, including indexing and selective query patterns.
* Build inbound and outbound integrations using REST/SOAP callouts, Platform Events, Named Credentials, and External Services.
* Participate in code review and follow a source-driven SDLC: Git-based version control, feature branching, SFDX, and automated deployment pipelines. Change-set-only deployment is not acceptable practice here.

**Platform Administration and Governance**

* Own user lifecycle, profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security; move the org toward a permission-set-driven model.
* Act as a gatekeeper for org changes: no direct production configuration, no unmanaged side deployments, no business-unit-local automation outside the governed pipeline.
* Administer license allocation across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, and Certinia, and report on utilization against contracted entitlements.
* Maintain org health: technical debt reduction, deactivation of unused fields and automations, retirement of Workflow Rules and Process Builder in favor of Flow.
* Enforce naming conventions, documentation standards, and metadata hygiene mechanically where possible — validation rules, required approvals, and automated checks rather than process reminders.
* Manage sandbox strategy, refresh cadence, and data seeding.
* Vet AppExchange packages for security review status, license model, and integration impact before installation.

**Integration and Consolidation**

* Support the ongoing consolidation of acquired-entity CRM and quoting processes onto the enterprise Salesforce org, including data mapping, deduplication, and cutover support.
* Maintain integrations between Salesforce, NetSuite, Certinia, and the enterprise integration layer (MuleSoft Anypoint Platform); work with the integration team on error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation.
* Support Salesforce CPQ configuration — product and price rules, bundles, quote templates, approval processes — and the handoff from closed-won to project delivery and billing.
* Contribute to data quality controls: duplicate rules, matching rules, required-field enforcement, and periodic audits.

**Support and Enablement**

* Serve as tier-2/3 escalation for Salesforce issues; triage, root-cause, and resolve within agreed service levels.
* Intake, size, and prioritize enhancement requests through a single backlog rather than ad hoc side channels.
* Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and report types for sales, delivery, and finance leadership.
* Produce release notes and deliver enablement to end users and business-unit admins after each release.
* Manage the three annual Salesforce releases: evaluate impact in preview sandboxes, test critical paths, and communicate changes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Salesforce development experience in a production environment with 200+ users.
* 2+ years writing production Apex, including triggers, asynchronous processing, and test classes.
* Demonstrated experience with Lightning Web Components and the Lightning App Builder.
* Strong Flow skills, including subflows, error handling, and Flow-to-Apex handoffs.
* Working knowledge of the Salesforce security and sharing model, including OWD, sharing rules, and manual and Apex sharing.
* Experience with Git-based version control and a modern deployment toolchain (SFDX, Gearset, Copado, Flosum, or equivalent).
* Experience integrating Salesforce with at least one ERP, finance, or PSA system.
* Salesforce Administrator certification.
* Professional written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
* Reliable home office setup and the ability to work the required overlap hours.

title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: Senior Manager Quality Engineering
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager, Quality Engineering

**Function:**
Quality Engineering / Software Testing

**Location:**
Gurugram or Kolkata

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

**About Company**

The company builds AI-powered SaaS for the U.S. dental market.

Its platform unifies analytics, communications, scheduling, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of solo practices, group practices, and DSOs rely on it daily.

It is a profitable SaaS business approaching eight figures in revenue. The company is mission-driven and execution-oriented — quality is designed in, not inspected in at the end.

If you want to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical and see clear, measurable impact, this is the place.

**Position Overview**

This role leads a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers and owns the modernization of how quality is built into the company's products. The mandate is to increase release confidence faster than QA headcount grows — through automation engineering, AI-assisted workflows, production observability, and shared quality ownership across Engineering, Product, and DevOps. This is a hands-on technical leadership position: the person in this role personally writes and reviews automation code, designs testing architecture, and investigates difficult production issues.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Establish a modern quality-engineering operating model based on shared ownership across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Quality Engineering; define risk-based testing strategies for critical customer workflows, integrations, and platforms.
* Own the architecture and evolution of web, API, integration, and end-to-end automation — personally build and maintain production-quality code in Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable libraries, fixtures, test-data systems, and parallel execution infrastructure.
* Integrate high-signal suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent); treat flaky and noisy tests as engineering defects and continuously improve execution speed, stability, and diagnosability.
* Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI assistants, call intelligence, and automated conversation workflows — build repeatable evaluations covering accuracy, hallucination risk, context retention, fallback logic, unsafe output, privacy, and latency.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents in daily engineering workflows across test design, automation development, code review, debugging, and incident analysis; establish practical AI-assisted workflows for the team and measure their impact on development time, maintenance effort, and release-validation speed.
* Investigate production and pre-production issues using SQL, logs, traces, API requests, browser developer tools, and monitoring platforms; lead root-cause analyses that address the architectural, testing, or observability gap that allowed a defect to escape.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers through clear goals, direct feedback, performance reviews, hiring, and career growth — raising the technical bar while scaling quality through better systems rather than linear headcount.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8+ years in software quality, test automation, or quality engineering, including 3+ years of people leadership managing and developing engineers.
* 4+ years of hands-on automation experience; personally written, reviewed, debugged, and maintained production automation code within the last 12 months.
* Strong software engineering ability in TypeScript or JavaScript; experience designing automation systems from the ground up, not only scripting within an existing framework.
* Strong experience with Playwright for browser automation and API testing; candidates from Selenium or Cypress must demonstrate current coding ability and a track record of modernizing legacy automation architecture.
* Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and improving execution reliability, speed, and diagnosability.
* Practical, current use of AI coding assistants or agents — able to describe specific workflows, measurable benefits, limitations encountered, and a concrete case where AI output was confidently wrong and how it was caught.
* Strong production-debugging skills using SQL, logs, traces, observability systems, and network-level tooling; demonstrated track record of improving quality without proportional growth in manual QA headcount.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience testing AI assistants, LLM-powered products, conversational systems, call intelligence, or automated communication workflows.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, dental technology, VoIP, payments, or other business-critical platforms.
* Experience with mobile automation, distributed architectures, third-party integrations, and asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, or observability testing.
* Track record of transforming a traditional QA team into a modern Quality Engineering organization.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a high-impact, technically ambitious quality engineering mandate at a profitable, product-led SaaS company.
* Direct influence on architecture, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices across a cross-functional team.
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission-driven, execution-oriented culture.
* Opportunity to build in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical with clear, measurable customer impact.
* Support for technical growth, career development, and contribution as a genuine engineering partner — not a process gatekeeper.

title: Principal Clinical Programmer
description:
**Job Description:**
Job Title: Principal Clinical Programmer
  
  
Location: India (Remote)
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Principal Clinical Data Programmer to join our Clinical EDC Programming team at Caidya. This role combines advanced technical expertise with clinical data strategy, collaborative problem-solving, and leadership in the evolution of clinical database design and integrated data management.
  
  
As the clinical research industry increasingly embraces quality by design, risk-based approaches, analytics, and AI-enabled technologies, the role of Clinical Programming is expanding beyond traditional database development. Our Principal Clinical Programmers are expected to help shape how studies are designed and configured, applying their technical knowledge alongside an understanding of protocol objectives, critical-to-quality factors, and downstream data review needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring extensive hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC, including advanced Custom Function programming, complex study builds, and clinical system integrations. Experience with Veeva Vault CDMS is preferred, while exposure to Medidata Designer, Clinical Data Studio (CDS), analytics, and AI-assisted workflows is an advantage.
  
  
Working closely with Data Management, Clinical Operations, sponsors, and other cross-functional teams, this individual will provide technical leadership, challenge traditional approaches where appropriate, influence database design decisions, and help advance Caidya's transition toward more integrated, efficient, and data-driven clinical trial processes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide technical leadership in the design, configuration, validation, and maintenance of complex clinical study databases in accordance with study protocols, SOPs, GCP, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Data Management and other study functions to translate protocol objectives, critical-to-quality factors, and data review requirements into effective clinical database design strategies.
* Lead collaborative database design discussions, evaluating alternative approaches and recommending solutions that balance data quality, operational efficiency, study complexity, and downstream analytics needs.
* Develop and maintain advanced edit checks, derivations, custom programming, and complex database configurations, providing expert guidance across EDC platforms.
* Provide technical oversight for complex study builds, database migrations, post-production changes, and integrations across clinical systems.
* Support the adoption and optimization of Medidata Designer, including AI-assisted study configuration and evolving approaches to protocol-driven database development.
* Contribute to the implementation and optimization of Clinical Data Studio (CDS), supporting integrated data review, analytics, external data ingestion, and risk-based data management capabilities.
* Collaborate with Data Management, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Monitoring, sponsors, and external partners to develop solutions that support cross-functional data review and high-quality clinical data delivery.
* Apply quality-by-design and risk-based principles to database configuration, validation strategies, and clinical data workflows.
* Provide technical expertise in evaluating complex programming challenges, system limitations, integration requirements, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Contribute to programming standards, global libraries, technical guidelines, and governance processes that support consistency and efficient study delivery.
* Mentor Clinical Programmers, promote critical thinking and collaborative problem-solving, and support the team's transition toward more consultative and strategically engaged roles.
* Identify and champion opportunities to improve clinical programming through automation, analytics, AI-assisted workflows, and emerging technologies.
* Collaborate with programming leadership and study teams to assess technical requirements, manage risks, and support delivery of study milestones.
* Actively contribute to the evolution of clinical programming practices, helping ensure that technical solutions remain aligned with changing industry expectations and clinical data management strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in computer science, life sciences, health informatics, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in clinical database design, clinical programming, and EDC systems within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC required, including advanced edit check programming, derivations, Custom Functions, and complex study build activities.
* Strong C# programming experience, particularly for Medidata Rave Custom Function development.
* Experience with complex database migrations, post-production changes, and clinical system integrations.
* Experience with Veeva Vault CDMS preferred; Medrio and Oracle InForm experience are also beneficial.
* Experience with Medidata Designer and/or Clinical Data Studio (CDS) is a plus.
* Strong understanding of clinical trial design, protocol requirements, GCP, regulatory expectations, and clinical data standards.
* Understanding of quality-by-design principles, risk-based data management, critical-to-quality factors, and integrated clinical data review approaches.
* Experience with centralized data review, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled clinical data workflows is beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex study requirements, challenge assumptions constructively, and recommend effective technical and operational solutions.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to influence cross-functional discussions and explain complex technical concepts.
* Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring colleagues, and contributing to process or technology improvements.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a forward-thinking approach to emerging technologies and evolving clinical data management practices.
* Ability to work independently, manage complex priorities, and collaborate effectively within a global, remote team.

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Be part of a growing, innovation-focused CRO where your expertise and ideas can directly influence how clinical data solutions are delivered.
* Help shape the evolution of clinical data management through quality-by-design principles, integrated data review, analytics, and AI-enabled technologies.
* Work with modern clinical platforms, including Medidata Rave, Designer, and Clinical Data Studio.
* Join collaborative global teams that value knowledge sharing, technical excellence, fresh perspectives, and continuous improvement.
* Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment that supports work-life balance.
* Gain exposure to diverse global studies, clients, and emerging clinical data strategies across multiple therapeutic areas.
* Contribute beyond study delivery through technical leadership, process optimization, innovation initiatives, and standards development.
* Experience the agility and visibility of a mid-sized CRO where individual contributions can make a meaningful impact.

If you are an experienced clinical programming professional who combines technical expertise with strategic thinking, enjoys challenging traditional approaches, and wants to help shape the future of clinical data management, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
V2
  
  
The company will not accept unsolicited resumes from third party vendors.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC, including edit checks, derivations, and Custom Functions, along with an interest in emerging technologies and new ways of working. Experience with Veeva Vault CDMS is preferred, while exposure to Medidata Designer, Clinical Data Studio (CDS), analytics, and AI-assisted workflows is an advantage.
  
  
This is an opportunity to contribute beyond traditional database programming, helping Caidya advance its clinical data capabilities through collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, configure, validate, and maintain clinical study databases in accordance with study protocols, SOPs, GCP, and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with Data Management and other study functions to interpret protocol requirements, identify critical data collection needs, and develop appropriate database design solutions.
* Participate actively in database design discussions, providing recommendations that consider data quality, usability, downstream review requirements, and study objectives.
* Develop and maintain eCRFs, edit checks, derivations, Custom Functions, and other clinical database components within EDC.
* Support study build, amendments, migrations, and post-production changes, evaluating the impact of proposed changes on data collection and review processes.
* Contribute to database configuration and review activities, including the adoption of AI-assisted study build capabilities and evolving technologies.
* Support Clinical Data Studio (CDS) configuration, data ingestion, listings, and analytics-related activities as applicable.
* Apply an understanding of risk-based data management and critical-to-quality factors when developing and validating clinical database solutions.
* Collaborate with Data Management, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Monitoring, sponsors, and external vendors to resolve technical and data-related challenges.
* Participate in UAT, production deployment, troubleshooting, and resolution of programming and database issues.
* Communicate programming progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to study teams and programming leadership.
* Contribute to programming standards, global libraries, process improvements, and the adoption of new technologies and ways of working.
* Support and mentor less experienced Clinical Programmers, promoting knowledge sharing, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in computer science, life sciences, health informatics, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in clinical database programming, EDC study design, and development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry.
* Strong hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC required, including study build, edit checks, derivations, and database configuration.
* Experience with Custom Function programming, C#, database migrations, and post-production change activities preferred.
* Experience with Veeva Vault CDMS preferred; Medrio and Oracle InForm experience are also beneficial.
* Experience with Medidata Designer and/or Clinical Data Studio (CDS) is a plus.
* Understanding of clinical trial processes, protocol requirements, GCP, regulatory expectations, and clinical data standards.
* Familiarity with risk-based data management, critical-to-quality principles, centralized data review, or clinical data analytics is beneficial.
* Interest in emerging technologies, automation, AI-assisted workflows, and their application to clinical data management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with cross-functional teams and contribute to technical and operational discussions.
* Adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches and embrace evolving processes.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities within a global, remote team.

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Be part of a growing, innovation-focused CRO where your expertise and ideas can directly contribute to how clinical data solutions are delivered.
* Help shape the future of clinical data management through integrated data review, analytics, and evolving AI-enabled technologies.
* Work with modern clinical platforms, including Medidata Rave, Designer, and Clinical Data Studio.
* Join collaborative global teams that value knowledge sharing, technical excellence, fresh perspectives, and continuous improvement.
* Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment that supports work-life balance.
* Gain exposure to diverse global studies, clients, and emerging clinical data strategies.
* Grow your technical and clinical data expertise while contributing to process improvement and innovation initiatives.
* Experience the agility and visibility of a mid-sized CRO where individual contributions make a meaningful impact.

If you are an experienced Clinical Programmer who enjoys solving problems, collaborating across disciplines, and exploring new approaches to clinical data management, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
V2
  
  
The company will not accept unsolicited resumes from third party vendors.

**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

title: Strategic Builder
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10-15 years of total experience with relevant 5 years into Data & AI in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or program management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and program management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Distributed Data Systems (India)
description:
**About Onehouse**
Onehouse is a mission-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real-time AI / ML).
  
  
We are a team of self-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self-optimizing data lake platform!
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category - the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudi's hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Drive:**- As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest.
Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudi's transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads.- Act as a SME to deepen our teams' expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing.
**A Typical Day:**

* Design new concurrency control and transactional capabilities that maximize throughput for competing writers.
* Design and implement new indexing schemes, specifically optimized for incremental data processing and analytical query performance.
* Design systems that help scale and streamline metadata and data access from different query/compute engines.
* Solve hard optimization problems to improve the efficiency (increase performance and lower cost) of distributed data processing algorithms over a Kubernetes cluster.
* Leverage data from existing systems to find inefficiencies, and quickly build and validate prototypes.
* Collaborate with other engineers to implement and deploy, safely rollout the optimized solutions in production.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Strong, object-oriented design and coding skills (Java and/or C/C++ preferably on a UNIX or Linux platform).
* Experience with inner workings of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases.
* You embrace ambiguous/undefined problems with an ability to think abstractly and articulate technical challenges and solutions.
* An ability to prioritize across feature development and tech debt with urgency and speed.
* An ability to solve complex programming/optimization problems.
* An ability to quickly prototype optimization solutions and analyze large/complex data.
* Experience running production services, at scale.
* Robust and clear communication skills.
* Nice to haves (but not required):
* Experience working with database systems, Query Engines or Spark codebases.
* Experience in optimization mathematics (linear programming, nonlinear optimization).
* Existing publications of optimizing large-scale data systems in top-tier distributed system conferences.
* PhD degree with 2+ years industry experience in solving and delivering high-impact optimization projects.

**How We'll Take Care Of You**

* Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
* Health & Well-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well-being by reimbursing up to 20,000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
* Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
* Location; we are a remote-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America + India), though some roles will be subject to in-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
* Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 17 paid company holidays
* Food & Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in-office snacks/drinks
* Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
* Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents - fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition

**House Values**
**One Team**
Optimize for the company, your team, self - in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of.
  
  
**Tough & Persevering**
We are building our company in a very large, fast-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!
  
  
**Keep Making It Better Always**
Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward.
  
  
**Think Big, Act Fast**
We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns.
  
  
**Be Customer Obsessed**
Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company.
